### Pelagos Insurance Capital to Present at the 2026 KBW Insurance Conference


August 25, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s202.q4cdn.com/796556884/files/doc_news/Pelagos-Insurance-Capital-to-Present-at-the-2026-KBW-Insurance-Conference-2026.pdf)


PEMBROKE, Bermuda--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Pelagos Insurance Capital Limited ("Pelagos Insurance Capital" or the "Company") (NYSE: PLGO), announced that Jonny Strickle, Group Managing Director, is scheduled to present at the 2026 KBW Insurance Conference in New York. The presentation will take place on Thursday, September 10, 2026, at 2:20 p.m. EDT.


A live, listen-only webcast of the presentation will be available via the Investors section of the Company’s website at[https://investors.pelagosinsurancecapital.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.pelagosinsurancecapital.com&esheet=54594510&newsitemid=20260825264667&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.pelagosinsurancecapital.com&index=1&md5=cde49f8e40eaeefe69be675a8fe5ef39) .


**About Pelagos Insurance Capital**


Pelagos Insurance Capital (NYSE: PLGO), formerly Fidelis Insurance Group (NYSE: FIHL), is an expert capital allocator and risk selector in specialty insurance and reinsurance. We bring together strategic capital and specialist underwriting expertise to deliver value through the cycle.


With a differentiated, diversified portfolio and strong balance sheet, we deploy capital into the most compelling areas of the market through our network of best-in-class underwriting partners. Our deep expertise and multiple points of access to the market enable us to adapt as the market evolves, optimize performance, and produce superior outcomes for clients, brokers, and shareholders.


Pelagos Insurance Capital makes the connections that matter in specialty risk.


For additional information about Pelagos Insurance Capital, our people, products and our insurer financial strength ratings please visit our website at[www.pelagosinsurancecapital.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.pelagosinsurancecapital.com&esheet=54594510&newsitemid=20260825264667&lan=en-US&anchor=www.pelagosinsurancecapital.com&index=2&md5=6f6d46f39ad193ce00652c4a65581e9c) .
